bsp_region_guard.name: BSP Region Guard

gui.bsp_region_guard.any_rank_may_enter_: any rank may enter (entry still applies)

gui.bsp_region_guard.changes_save_at_onc: Changes save at once. Esc closes.
gui.bsp_region_guard.cross_server_destin: cross-server destinations (server/world) are carried out by BSP Teleport
gui.bsp_region_guard.edge.title: THE EDGE OF THE WORLD

gui.bsp_region_guard.inherited_from_pare: %s flags inherited from the parent: see FLAGS (violet hints)
gui.bsp_region_guard.largest_side_in_blo: largest side in blocks; empty uses the config
gui.bsp_region_guard.luckperms_group_nam: LuckPerms group name, Enter to add

gui.bsp_region_guard.making_it_a_mine_al: Making it a mine allows breaking and refuses placing inside.
gui.bsp_region_guard.map_scale.many: 1 px = %s blocks - wheel zooms - click a region - double-click opens FLAGS
gui.bsp_region_guard.map_scale.one: 1 px = %s block - wheel zooms - click a region - double-click opens FLAGS
gui.bsp_region_guard.may_build_and_pass_: may build and pass entry rules
gui.bsp_region_guard.may_edit_the_region: may edit the region and build
gui.bsp_region_guard.message_enter_to_sa: message, Enter to save, empty clears
gui.bsp_region_guard.move_players_on_ent: move players on entering, leaving, a timer, or server shutdown
gui.bsp_region_guard.name: NAME
gui.bsp_region_guard.new_region_id_enter: new region id, Enter: from the wand selection, or click its corners on the map
gui.bsp_region_guard.no_other_server_s_w: No other server's world with a border and a free edge is known.
gui.bsp_region_guard.not_a_mine_a_mine_r: Not a mine. A mine refills itself with the blocks you list, on a timer, and lets anyone inside dig.
gui.bsp_region_guard.not_set_the_top_of_: not set: the top of the region's centre
gui.bsp_region_guard.only_these_ranks_ma: only these ranks may enter, besides members
gui.bsp_region_guard.open_cost: %s pieces per block, plots %s to %s blocks a side
gui.bsp_region_guard.or_with_claim_buy_o: Land Office. Open areas let you outline your own plot with the plot tool.
gui.bsp_region_guard.parent_region_id_en: parent region id, Enter to set, empty for none

gui.bsp_region_guard.players_inside_are_: players inside are moved to the spawn (or above the mine) when it resets; warnings 60 s and 10 s before
gui.bsp_region_guard.players_outline_the: players outline their own plot inside and pay per block of ground
gui.bsp_region_guard.plots_for_sale_are_: Plots for sale are the gold boxes in the world; buy them at a
gui.bsp_region_guard.price_in_shatter_pi: price in Shatter Pieces; 0 takes it off sale
gui.bsp_region_guard.sale_line_open: open area: outline your own plot
gui.bsp_region_guard.seconds_between_res: seconds between resets; empty stops them
gui.bsp_region_guard.set_a_border_there_: Set a border there; this list reads the shared storage when the tab opens.
gui.bsp_region_guard.shatter_pieces_per_: Shatter Pieces per block of ground; 0 closes the area
gui.bsp_region_guard.smallest_side_in_bl: smallest side in blocks; empty uses the config
gui.bsp_region_guard.the_admin_has_not_a: the admin has not allowed any rules on this plot
gui.bsp_region_guard.the_heaviest_block_: the heaviest block fills the mine, the others grow as veins
gui.bsp_region_guard.the_owner_gives_it_: The owner gives it up with /claim abandon; an admin can too. An admin plot then goes back on sale.
gui.bsp_region_guard.the_world_default_a: The world default applies everywhere no other region decides.
gui.bsp_region_guard.the_world_default_c: The world default cannot be a mine.
The world default cannot be sold.
gui.bsp_region_guard.trigger_hint: here | world x y z | server/world x y z [message]
gui.bsp_region_guard.trigger_hint_timer: seconds, then: here | world x y z | server/world x y z [message]
gui.bsp_region_guard.unset_flags_take_th: unset flags take the parent's values
gui.bsp_region_guard.you_have_no_claim_i: You have no claim in this world yet.
gui.bsp_region_guard.your_plot_and_what_: your plot and what is around it - wheel zooms
gui.bsp_region_guard.strangers_may_use_d: strangers may use doors and switches
gui.bsp_region_guard.strangers_may_use_m: strangers may use machines and animals
gui.bsp_region_guard.read_only_hint: another server's regions: nothing can be changed here
gui.bsp_region_guard.wipe_summary.one: This removes the %s claim (%s player) in this world.
gui.bsp_region_guard.wipe_summary.many: This removes all %s claims (%s players) in this world, bought plots included.
gui.bsp_region_guard.wipe_none: There are no claims in this world.

gui.bsp_region_guard.wipe_footer: the same steps as /rg claims wipe

gui.bsp_region_guard.banned_hint_2: Drag a banned block back here, or press x, to allow it again.
gui.bsp_region_guard.nothing_banned_yet: Nothing banned here. Drag blocks in.
gui.bsp_region_guard.hover_a_banned_bloc: Hover a banned block to see its rules.
gui.bsp_region_guard.banned_popup_remove: Remove them from your inventory to enter.
gui.bsp_region_guard.banned_popup_chest: A chest outside the region will keep them safe.
gui.bsp_region_guard.size_hint: click a number, type, Enter saves - Esc puts it back

gui.bsp_region_guard.pm_heights_run: the height runs from %s to %s, lower first

gui.bsp_region_guard.pm_draw_second: first corner x %s, z %s - click the second corner (x %s, z %s)
gui.bsp_region_guard.pm_type_an_id: type an id: letters, digits, _ or -
gui.bsp_region_guard.pm_id_taken: a region with that id is already here
gui.bsp_region_guard.pm_needs_price: a plot for sale needs a price above 0
gui.bsp_region_guard.pm_pick_to_reshape: click a region to reshape it
gui.bsp_region_guard.pm_fits: fits at x %s, z %s, y %s to %s - click the copy to drag it
